## LinkedIn Lead Generation + AI Qualification

### How it works

This workflow manually starts a LinkedIn lead generation run, fetches profile data through Apify, and prepares the profile records with custom JavaScript. It sends the prepared leads to an AI Agent powered by OpenRouter to qualify or enrich them, then parses the agent output. Finally, it appends the structured qualification results to a Google Sheet.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Apify credentials and set the LinkedIn profile/search actor input to match the target lead source.
- Configure the OpenRouter Chat Model credentials and choose the model the AI Agent should use for qualification.
- Review both JavaScript Code nodes to ensure the input formatting and AI response parsing match the Apify output and desired sheet columns.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and select the destination spreadsheet, sheet, and column mapping for appended rows.

### Customization

Adjust the Apify search parameters, the AI Agent qualification prompt, scoring criteria, and the Google Sheets columns to fit your ideal customer profile and reporting needs.

## Fetch and prepare leads

Starts the workflow manually, retrieves LinkedIn profile data via Apify, and uses custom JavaScript to prepare the fetched profiles for AI qualification.

## Qualify leads with AI

Runs the prepared LinkedIn lead data through an AI Agent, using the connected OpenRouter chat model to evaluate or qualify each profile.

## Parse and save results

Parses the AI Agent response into structured fields and appends the qualified lead information as new rows in Google Sheets.

I am a Computer Systems Technician (Networking) at Algonquin College in Ottawa and the founder of CognaWorks Inc. Anchor: a government spending and procurement accountability platform that flags recipients of public funds from open Canadian data, with machine-learning anomaly detection and entity resolution. An earlier version placed 3rd at the Agency 2026 National AI Hackathon (Government of Alberta).

I hold a Government of Canada Reliability Clearance. I built my first automated growing chamber at sixteen and was a finalist at an international science olympiad, then moved to Canada.
The combination is the point: the formal grounding of a systems and networking technician, plus the proven ability to build and ship real systems from the network all the way up to the user. Most people work one of those layers. I work the whole stack.

We focus on democratizing access to large-scale energy projects by providing financing opportunities for small investors. By bridging the gap between investors and sustainable energy ventures, we aim to make impactful projects accessible to a wider audience and drive the transition to clean energy.

At Lion Solar Solutions, I played a key role in designing and optimizing photovoltaic (PV) systems for diverse applications worldwide. My expertise in solar energy solutions, combined with a data-driven approach, allowed me to develop over 10,000 PV projects, with most of them successfully implemented across various regions.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:
Designed & Optimized Solar Energy Systems:

* Developed tailored residential, commercial, and utility-scale PV solutions to maximize efficiency and return on investment.
* Conducted feasibility studies, energy yield assessments, and shading analysis using industry-leading software (e.g., PVSol, AutoCAD, PVSyst, etc.).
* Ensured compliance with international regulations and grid connection requirements to guarantee project viability.

Project Implementation & Global Impact:

* Delivered scalable and cost-effective solar energy solutions that contributed to the widespread adoption of renewable energy worldwide.
* Worked closely with cross-functional teams, including engineers, procurement specialists, and project managers, to streamline design-to-installation workflows.

Mentoring & Leadership:

* Led and mentored interns and junior engineers, providing hands-on training in PV system design, software tools, and industry best practices.
* Fostered a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment, ensuring team growth and technical excellence.
* Throughout my tenure, I was committed to pushing the boundaries of solar technology and delivering high-performance PV systems that drive sustainability and energy efficiency on a global scale.

During my internship at Onur Enerji, a consultancy firm specializing in energy audits and loss assessments, I gained hands-on experience in energy efficiency analysis, tariff optimization, and field measurements. The firm focused on identifying energy losses in buildings, utilizing various specialized equipment to measure inefficiencies and calculate the costs and benefits of corrective actions.

Key Responsibilities & Achievements:

* Electricity Tariff Optimization Algorithm:

   * Developed an Excel-based algorithm to analyze electricity bills and recommend the most cost-effective tariff (single-time vs. three-time pricing).
   * Integrated real-time electricity price data from EPDK (Energy Market Regulatory Authority) for accurate comparisons.
   * Applied regression analysis to forecast future electricity costs based on dollar exchange rate trends, helping clients make data-driven decisions.

* Energy Loss Analysis & Field Experience:

   * Gained hands-on experience with measurement equipment used to detect energy inefficiencies in buildings.
   * Conducted on-site energy audits, assessed consumption patterns, and learned how to interpret data for efficiency improvements.
   *Contributed to cost-benefit analyses, calculating the return on investment (ROI) for energy-saving recommendations.

This internship provided me with valuable field exposure and technical expertise in energy consultancy, bridging the gap between data-driven analysis and practical energy solutions.

This organization is dedicated to providing support and care to the homeless and those who lack access to basic necessities.

My role involves more than just distributing meals—it's about creating a sense of community and offering a glimmer of hope to those facing challenging circumstances. By engaging directly with individuals who benefit from our efforts, I have developed a deeper understanding of social responsibility, empathy, and the value of small actions in making a significant difference.

This experience has enriched my perspective on the importance of giving back to the community and reinforced my commitment to supporting sustainable and impactful initiatives.
